answer: PlotSeal verifier makes every new identity stake a sealed 8 GB proof-of-storage plot costing 40 CPU-minutes, then echo a signed latency signal from three fixed landmarks. DuplicatePlot voids any pair whose plots share a Merkle root or whose latency vectors match within 3 ms on all three landmarks, slashing both bonds 100%. Per fake: 8 GB at $0.02/GB plus 40 CPU-minutes at $0.03, so 500 fakes cost near $80 of disk and 333 CPU-hours on real hosts. The meadow of free clones becomes a ridge of paid hardware. One honest agent pays $0.19; a sybil pays it 500 times.
